title: Making Disciples
definition: Making disciples is obeying Christ's command to lead others toward faith, baptism, teaching, obedience, and maturity in Him.
summary: Making disciples means helping others follow Jesus faithfully.
christFocus: Jesus commands His followers to make disciples of all nations, teaching them to obey all He commanded.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Making disciples is the mission Christ gave His Church. It includes evangelism, baptism, teaching, encouragement, correction, example, and patient investment in spiritual growth.

Disciples are not made merely by transferring information. They are formed through truth, relationship, obedience, prayer, and life together under the lordship of Jesus.

Every believer has a role in this mission. Some teach publicly, some mentor personally, some parent faithfully, some encourage quietly, but all are called to help others follow Christ.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Churches can become busy without making disciples. Making disciples matters because Christ did not command His people merely to gather crowds, but to form obedient followers.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Identify one person you can encourage in Christ. Share Scripture, pray with them, model obedience, and help them take the next step of faith.
